scenarios.name: Apply staged commands for two ribbon targets together

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are initially empty
the Ribbon customization dialog shows the Part Tools target and All Commands
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Tools custom panel
the user selects the Part Manage target
the user adds "3D Annotations" to its custom panel
the customization dialog remains open on the Part Manage target
its list contains "3D Annotations" without a pending-change marker
the Tools ribbon displays a User Commands panel
the user selects the Part Tools target
its list contains "2D Sketches" without a pending-change marker
